extracted.intended_audience: Investigators preparing NIH-format biographical sketches (senior/key personnel and other significant contributors) for grant applications (context: F99/K00)
extracted.subtask_description: Fill out NIH-format Biographical Sketches for senior/key personnel and other significant contributors, following the provided section headings and page limits; include education/training, personal statement, positions and honors, contributions to science, and research support. Applicable to individual biosketch entries within an NIH grant (e.g., F99/K00 application).

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall instruction and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow this format for each person. All biographical sketch content for each individual must fit within the five-page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Header information (Name / eRA Commons / Position Title)
rubrics_metrics.description:
NAME: [person's name]
 eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login):
 POSITION TITLE: [current title]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the individual's full name, their eRA Commons username or credential, and current position title as the header for the biosketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training section
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or initial professional education, include postdoctoral and residency training.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List Institution and location, Degree (if applicable), Completion Date MM/YYYY, and Field of Study. Begin with the baccalaureate or initial professional education and include postdoctoral/residency training as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise statement describing the individual's qualifications for the proposed role on the project and how they will contribute. Examples in text show statements of intended contributions (e.g., 'As a primary sponsor, I will leverage my expertise to guide this project through completion. I will provide input on research design, variables construction, data analysis, data interpretation, and manuscript writing.'). Include relevant expertise, prior experience, mentorship record, and any specific roles/tasks to be performed for the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List positions and employment history (with dates) and honors/awards. Include other experience, appointments, editorial roles, advisory roles, and honors that establish qualifications and track record.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the major contributions the individual has made to their field. Structure can include numbered contribution areas (e.g., 1., 2., 3., ...), each with a brief narrative summarizing the contribution and its significance, followed by selected representative publications supporting that contribution. Use examples to illustrate format (each contribution followed by lettered list of related publications).

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Additional Information: Research Support and/or Scholastic Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Additional Information: Research Support and/or Scholastic Performance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List ongoing and completed research support relevant to the individual's work. For each entry include funding source (agency), grant number, project title, dates, the individual's role (e.g., PI, consultant), and a brief description of the study and the individual's responsibilities/activities on the project. Distinguish ongoing versus completed support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the provided format for each person
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the same sections and formatting to each senior/key personnel or significant contributor included in the application; keep each person's biosketch within the five-page limit and include the specified sections (header, education/training, A–D).
